title: What UX is — conversation-first opening

turns.text: Before we start... what do people actually mean by UX? Is it the screen?

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: That's what we're going to find out in this chapter. We'll follow Maya as she tries to get an appointment, then see why a working screen can still leave her stuck.

turns.speaker: guide

turns.text: And she's already waited days for the referral. Imagine putting the phone down now.

turns.speaker: alex
turns.text: I'd wonder whether to wait, call, or start over. I wouldn't feel done.

turns.speaker: guide

turns.text: Exactly. The screen gave feedback. Maya still doesn't know if she's closer to care.

turns.speaker: alex

turns.text: So the experience isn't just that message. It's the whole attempt to get help.

turns.speaker: guide
turns.text: Yes. What she needed, what she tried, what happened next, and what she could trust. That's the question we'll carry through the course.
